title: What is the return on investment with an in-house photo studio?
h1: In-House Photo Studio: Cost Reduction and Creativity
metaTitle: In-House Photo Studio: Reduce Your Costs and Improve Your Creativity
description: Opt for an automated in-house photo studio. Lower your costs, save time, and create quality visuals with ease.
author: PackshotCreator
content:
The internalization of photographic production represents a major strategic lever for businesses looking to optimize their creative processes and strengthen their competitiveness. With the evolution of automation technologies, investing in an internal photo studio is no longer limited to the simple acquisition of equipment: it is a transformative approach aimed at revolutionizing the value chain for product visuals.

The In-House Photo Studio: Pivot of a Global Economic Strategy

Whether it is used for an e-commerce platform (furniture photography, internal photography for the food industry, photos of parapharmacy articles...), the creation of a stock of digital images intended for archiving or even for Quality Control, the in-house photo studio meets a decisive criterion: the global economic strategy.

‍

‍

This approach is accompanied by economies of scale in many areas, which are not always thought of at first glance, such as the time it takes to bring a product to the market or the responsiveness to the arrival of new references.

Logistics Optimization and Reduction of Intermediaries

Les automated photo solutions eliminate time-consuming back and forth with external service providers. In the sectors of furnishings And of the fast fashion, the responsiveness to the arrival of new collections is increased tenfold, allowing up to 50% faster marketing.

Concretely, an in-house photo studio avoids:

  • The delivery of products between several sites
  • Dependence on external suppliers
  • Hidden transport costs, which are particularly significant for bulky or fragile items

Economies of Scale: Increasing Profitability with Volume

As in any industry, the increase in production must go hand in hand with a reduction in final costs “per piece”. The use of an automated shooting solution answers this problem: The more you shoot, the more the cost per photo falls.

‍

‍

The average cost per packshot drops significantly when switching from a traditional studio to an automated studio — use our ROI calculator to estimate the reduction for your own volume. This dynamic is reinforced by the ability to simultaneously generate several formats (web, print, 360°) without marginal additional costs.

Operational Gains: Time, Flexibility and Quality Control

Industrialization of Shooting Processes

An in-house photo studio is a professional solution for the rapid creation of product visuals. The benefits of industrialization include:

  • Real-time preview via the control screen, eliminating trial and error
  • Adaptive lighting guaranteeing light homogeneity
  • Light control for an impeccable result

Orbitvu Station software features also include:

  • Automated retouching, renaming, and editing : simplifies post-processing by automating repetitive tasks.
  • Full studio automation : integrated control of lights, cameras and turntables for captures without manual intervention.
  • Batch processing : reduces post-production time by up to 70% by applying simultaneous changes to multiple files.
  • Interactive content creation: easily generate 360° animations, product videos, and interactive presentations.
  • Integration with third party platforms : compatibility with PIM systems, DAM systems and e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, Magento and PrestaShop.
  • Real-time preview : instant display on a control screen for precise adjustments

By combining these functionalities, Orbitvu Station is positioned as an essential tool for businesses that want to improve the quality and efficiency of their visual production.

Reducing “Human Time” and Refocusing on Key Competencies

A controlled and software-assisted shooting solution makes it easy to upload a photograph online, taking into account the creative steps that take place after the shutter is released.
‍

‍

For example, the software supplied with the machines allows you to:

  • Generate QR codes in a few clicks
  • Diverting intuitively A photographed object
  • Centralize a set of tasks that usually require several services

These automations allow teams to focus on strategic missions such as analysing visual performance or optimizing cross-channel campaigns.

Responsiveness and Optimization of Decisions

Internalization goes hand in hand withspeeding up decision-making processes. The time saved between the moment the decision is taken and the posting of a visual online is drastically reduced.

With an in-house studio, the time between the launch decision and the publication of the visuals increases from several days to a few hours. This agility is crucial for:

  • Grasp the flash promotional opportunities (sales, limited launches)
  • Responding to emerging trends on social networks
  • Apprehend pivotal periods such as sales with serenity
  • Get ahead of the competition

AI Integration: Future-Proofing Visual Production

Recent advances in artificial intelligence are revolutionizing the photo ecosystem:

  • Automatic correction imperfections (reflections, dust) via neural networks
  • Generation of stylistic variants aligned with brand DNA, A/B tested in real time
  • SEO optimization metadata and legends using natural language processing

However, AI does not replace human expertise: it amplifies the creativity of teams by managing repetitive tasks.

Conclusion: An Investment with a Multidimensional ROI

Logistical gains, economies of scale, time savings, responsiveness and optimization are essential factors to take into account when calculating your Return on Investment (ROI).

The internalization of photographic production offers a triple return on investment:

  1. Financial : Rapid depreciation thanks to recurring savings
  2. Operational : 40% gain in overall time on the visual channel
  3. Strategic : Differentiation through innovation and increased responsiveness

Other more qualitative factors must also be integrated to measure the impact of the investment:

  • Controlling your agenda
  • Independence from external service providers
  • The possibility of determining your own quality criteria

Pioneering businesses are already seeing an increase of 15 to 30% of their e-commerce conversion rate after internalization.

faqs.question: How do Orbitvu solutions improve productivity in product photography?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu's automated devices integrate hardware and software to simplify the content creation process. This integration allows for rapid image capture, automated post-production, and efficient publishing, reducing the time and effort needed to produce high-quality visuals.

faqs.question: How does an in-house photo studio stimulate creativity within teams?
faqs.answer: Having an in-house studio gives teams the freedom to experiment with new ideas and concepts without the time or budget constraints associated with outsourcing. This autonomy encourages innovation and allows rapid adaptation to market trends.

faqs.question: How does Orbitvu ensure visual consistency in productions?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu allows specific configurations to be saved for each type of product, guaranteeing uniformity in lighting, shooting angles and post-production settings. This coherence reinforces the visual identity of the brand across all media.

faqs.question: Are Orbitvu solutions suitable for users without photography expertise?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Orbitvu solutions are designed to be user-friendly, allowing even operators with no previous experience to produce professional visuals. The automation of complex settings and the use of templates make it easy to quickly get started with equipment.

faqs.question: What types of content can be created with Orbitvu solutions?
faqs.answer: Orbitvu solutions offer the flexibility to produce a variety of content types, including still photography, 360 animations, product videos, and interactive presentations. This versatility meets the varied needs of businesses in terms of visual communication.
